Response of ListarCadastroServico (servicos/servico) — paged list of registered services. Used to resolve a service's unit price/description by its nCodServ. The servicos/servico endpoint pages with the n-prefixed keys (nPagina/nTotPaginas/nRegistros/nTotRegistros), not the generic pagina/total_de_paginas.
